R142b - corrected C37 writer-admission validator for PS3 board-ad rasters (after-receipt-6 prompt, first package; answers the receipt-6
review findings 1-3). Research probe, NOT a Studio writer. Separates:
  discover(b)  format discovery (census reader): every board material -> descriptor -> format name incl. DXT5, no admission;
  admit(b)     writer admission: the R142 checks plus
               - overlap: the selected data span is refused if it intersects ANY other non-empty data span (full pairwise test:
                 enclosing, non-adjacent, equal-start, duplicate); spans that only touch at a boundary are allowed; empty spans ignored;
               - formats: 83f1 (DXT1) and 83f2 (DXT3) only; 83f3 (DXT5) is discovered but refused;
               - width, height and level count must be > 0 (no normalisation to 1); width / height <= 8192 and
                 level count <= 1 + floor(log2(max(w, h))) (bounded arithmetic; a declared partial chain is kept as declared);
               - format words u16 @34 and @38 must be equal.
Vectors: the 14 R142 vectors (same builder) + focused new vectors (the review's enclosing construction and siblings, DXT3 pass, DXT5
refusal, zero width / height / levels, excess levels, format-word mismatch, touching and empty spans allowed, partial chain kept).
Census replay (--census): the admission validator over every PS3 venue package (read-only; archive members unwrapped in memory) compared
with R142's edge counts, to show the new checks keep the measured legitimate inputs.
Usage: python r142b_c37_admission_validator.py <out.json> [--census]
